description: Take one race off the user's list, the same list save_race and add_custom_race write to. Pass race_id or race_slug from get_calendar, or the url from search_races, or the title (+ date when the same race is listed twice). Several matches come back as ambiguous and nothing is removed. Training sessions are never touched; remove_sessions does those. Where the user has Google Calendar connected, the race's event goes too. All dates are the user's local calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in their own time zone. Requires signing in.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, narrows title when the same race is listed twice.

race_id.description: id of the race on the user's list, from get_calendar.

race_slug.description: brand/year/slug from get_calendar, search_races or save_race.

title.description: The race name as the list shows it, when there is no id or slug.

url.description: The race url from search_races, instead of race_slug.

name: remove_race
title: Remove a race from the list
